Subject: Strategic goal clarity and resource checklist — Q4 kickoff

Team,

Kicking off the quarter planning thread for Q4 objectives. I put together a short playbook draft (attached) that lays out:
- Proposed objectives + measurable signals
- Cross-team dependencies we already know about
- Resource checklist (headcount, infra spend, external integrations)

Please review the attached goal_playbook_v1.pdf and the resource_sheet_q4.xlsx. Key asks for this week: 
1) Each owner should confirm the measurable signal for their objective (metric + target).
2) Call out any non-negotiable dependencies and a single DRI for each.
3) Provide an initial resource estimate (FTEs, infra $) in the sheet by EOD Friday.

A few notes up front:
- We must finalize objectives by next Tues 9/7 to allow CS and sales to align quotas.
- If an objective requires >2 FTEs or any external procurement, flag it now so we can route approvals.

I'll consolidate and surface conflicts at Monday leadership check.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Head of Platform Product
Redwood Inference

Attachments: goal_playbook_v1.pdf (18 KB), resource_sheet_q4.xlsx (12 KB)

Thanks Dylan — good and pragmatic structure. A couple quick clarifications: 

- On measurable signals: please call out if the metric is a leading vs lagging indicator. For product adoption objectives we want 2 leading signals where possible.
- On timeline: can we set a hard freeze for objective changes on Friday 9/10? That gives GTM a week to prepare.

I've filled the first tab of resource_sheet_q4 with baseline headcount numbers for my org and noted a few hiring reqs that will likely need approval. See the inline comments in the sheet.

Also: Marcus, can you confirm the infra delta (GPU hours) for the new batch/hot path we discussed? If it's >20% we'll need to queue a Dedicated capacity brief.

Laura
